title: Qum se aati ha Sada Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
body:
Qum se aati hai sada, Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<MINI>>
Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba ,Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<DIVIDER>>
Beqata maara gaya Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<MINI>>
Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba ,Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Haaye Mamoon(l.a) ne ye kaisa sitam kardaala
Ibne Ahmad ke liye Zehre Dagha Bhijwaaya
Bewatan Maara gaya Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<MINI>>
Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Mere bhayya main yaha'n aayi thi tumse milne
ab jo tum hi na rahe kya kare behna jeeke
Jeena dushwaar hua Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<MINI>>
Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kaale parcham hai lage soug me tere har su
Mere bhayya main kaha'n paoongi teri khushboo
Mujhko itna to bata Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<MINI>>
Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Sab ke zamin ho tum aur zamin e aahoo hai laqab
Aisa sam tumko mila khaate hi neele hue lab
yu'n ki ummat ne dagha Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<MINI>>
Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Baba Kazim(a.s) ko zaher qaid me hi bhijwaaya
TUmko bhi bhai mere zehre sitam se maara
Mera kuch bhi na bacha Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<MINI>>
Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Tu Ghareebul Ghoraba aur main khwahar teri
Ek Ghareeb aur hai karbal me churi jispa chali
Na kafan usko mila Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<MINI>>
Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Bhai ko rote hue Zainab e Muztar(s.a) guzri
Sog me bhai tere mera bhi sar hai zaqmi
Ye bahen tujhpe fida Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<MINI>>
Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<DIVIDER>>
8.
Asghari
Karti hai matam tere gham me bhayya Aur
Mirza
ne tere gham me hai nouha ye likha
Inko mashad tu bula Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
<<MINI>>
Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba Aye Ghareebul Ghoraba
